name: copilot-llm-bridge
description: Expose VS Code's Language Model API (GitHub Copilot's chat models) as a local OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint, for other local tools to use as an LLM base URL.

chatParticipants.name: remote
chatParticipants.description: Forwards this message to another VS Code+Copilot instance's own Copilot LLM Bridge and streams its reply back.

commands.title: Copilot LLM Bridge: Copy Base URL

copilotLlmBridge.port.description: Port the local OpenAI-compatible server listens on (127.0.0.1 only).

copilotLlmBridge.vendor.description: vscode.lm model vendor to select from, e.g. "copilot".

copilotLlmBridge.family.description: Preferred model family (e.g. "gpt-4o", "claude-3.5-sonnet"). Empty picks whatever selectChatModels() returns first; use "Select Model..." to choose explicitly.

copilotLlmBridge.autoStart.description: Start the bridge server automatically when VS Code opens this workspace. Off by default: the first model access must be user-initiated (a command), not silent, to trigger Copilot's own consent prompt correctly.

copilotLlmBridge.sharedSecret.description: Optional bearer token other local processes must send (Authorization: Bearer <token>) to use the bridge. Empty disables the check. The server only ever binds to 127.0.0.1 regardless.

copilotLlmBridge.remoteTargets.description: Other VS Code+Copilot instances' own Copilot LLM Bridge endpoints, reachable from this one's @remote chat participant.

name.description: Short name used to pick this target, e.g. "@remote @work ..." when more than one is configured.

baseUrl.description: The other instance's bridge base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4319/v1 (same-machine) or a tunnelled/tailnet URL for a different machine.

sharedSecret.description: Matches that instance's own copilotLlmBridge.sharedSecret, if it set one.
